<task type="auto">
  <name>Task 2: Live API smoke — health sha, CORS, publish and read-back</name>
  <precondition>https://api.characterdossierlab.app resolves and Railway reports the deployment healthy (Task 1 complete).</precondition>
  <files>apps/api/scripts/live-smoke.mjs</files>
  <read_first>
    - apps/api/scripts/smoke.mjs
    - apps/api/src/__tests__/cors.spec.ts, shares.route.spec.ts (expected shapes)
  </read_first>
  <action>
1. Write `apps/api/scripts/live-smoke.mjs` (record()/PASS/FAIL, global fetch, no dependencies). Env: `API_URL`, `APP_ORIGIN`, `EXPECT_VERSION`. Checks:
   - `GET /healthz` returns 200 with ok true and version === EXPECT_VERSION.
   - OPTIONS `/v1/shares` with Origin APP_ORIGIN and `Access-Control-Request-Method: POST`: allow-origin equals APP_ORIGIN.
   - The same with Origin `https://evil.example`: no allow-origin.
   - POST a header-only snapshot with Origin APP_ORIGIN: 201.
   - GET it: 200, adult false, Cache-Control contains immutable, nosniff present.
   - POST a snapshot with one intimacy page (default data, adult false claimed): 201; GET shows adult true.
   - `GET /v1/shares` is 404.
   - Print `CREATED <id>` for each share and exit 1 on any FAIL.
2. Run it with `API_URL=https://api.characterdossierlab.app APP_ORIGIN=https://characterdossierlab.app EXPECT_VERSION=$(git rev-parse HEAD)`. Keep the two ids for Task 3 and for cleanup.
3. If `/healthz` never returns 200 within 5 minutes, read the Railway deploy logs through the user rather than guessing. A boot failure prints `invalid environment:` with the key names.
  </action>
  <verify>
    <automated>API_URL=https://api.characterdossierlab.app APP_ORIGIN=https://characterdossierlab.app EXPECT_VERSION=$(git rev-parse HEAD) node apps/api/scripts/live-smoke.mjs</automated>
    <fails_when>non-zero exit, or any output line starting with "FAIL", or fewer than two "CREATED" lines</fails_when>
  </verify>
  <acceptance_criteria>
    - The command passes and prints two CREATED lines.
    - `rg -q 'evil\.example' apps/api/scripts/live-smoke.mjs` exits 0.
  </acceptance_criteria>
  <done>The deployed API reports the pushed commit, answers only the app origin cross-origin, and publishes immutable snapshots with a server-computed adult flag.</done>
</task>

<task type="auto">
  <name>Task 3: Deploy the web app, verify the live share flow in a browser, clean up test shares</name>
  <files>none (deploy and verification only)</files>
  <read_first>
    - apps/web/wrangler.jsonc, apps/web/_worker.js
    - docs/specs/SPEC-deployment.md (7 deploy checklist)

  <action>
1. `pnpm --filter web exec wrangler whoami`. If unauthenticated, raise an auth gate for `wrangler login` and retry.
2. `pnpm --filter web wrangler:deploy`. The custom-domain routes attach the apex and www in the Cloudflare zone.
3. HTTP checks (command below): www returns 301 to the apex; the apex `/s/<id>` returns HTML with the CSP connect-src directive.
4. Playwright, in a fresh context each time:
   - Open the adult id from Task 2 at 400 px: only the content notice; acknowledge; header and Intimacy page render with zero input/textarea/select; reload shows no notice.
   - Open the header-only id: no notice.
   - Open `/s/notavalidid`: "This link doesn't lead to a dossier".
   - On `/`, create a character, open Share, publish: "Link copied" or "Copy the link below" with a URL on the apex that opens read-only in a new context.
   - Record ids created here for cleanup.
5. Clean up every id created in Tasks 2-3 with `aws s3api delete-object --bucket character-dossier-prod --key shares/snap/<id>.json.gz`, using the 03-07 credential inline (it has DeleteObject). Delete via the API ships in Phase 5.
6. Record URLs, check results and the cleanup list in the SUMMARY.
  </action>
  <verify>
    <automated>node --input-type=module -e "const w=await fetch('https://www.characterdossierlab.app/c/x',{redirect:'manual'});const a=await fetch('https://characterdossierlab.app/s/s0000000000000000000000000',{headers:{Accept:'text/html'}});const csp=a.headers.get('content-security-policy')||'';const body=await a.text();if(w.status!==301||w.headers.get('location')!=='https://characterdossierlab.app/c/x'||a.status!==200||!body.includes('<cd-root')||!csp.includes(\"connect-src 'self' https://api.characterdossierlab.app\")){console.error('LIVE-WEB-FAILED',w.status,w.headers.get('location'),a.status,csp);process.exit(1)}"</automated>
    <fails_when>non-zero exit, or "LIVE-WEB-FAILED" in stderr</fails_when>
    <human-check>Playwright run from step 4: adult share gated then read-only, remembered after reload; non-adult share ungated; invalid id shows the not-found page; a share published from the live UI opens read-only in a fresh context. Attach screenshots to the SUMMARY.</human-check>
  </verify>
  <acceptance_criteria>
    - The command passes and the Playwright run completes every step in 4.
    - The SUMMARY lists every created share id, and each was deleted (`aws s3api head-object` for each key returns 403 or 404 afterwards).
  </acceptance_criteria>
  <done>Anyone with a link on https://characterdossierlab.app can open a read-only dossier served through the live API, gated when adult.</done>
</task>

<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| internet to API (Railway TLS) | public share endpoints |
| internet to Worker (Cloudflare) | SPA and redirects |
| Railway variables | production secrets |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Severity | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-03-08-01 | Spoofing | CORS in production | high | mitigate | Live preflight checks for app origin and a foreign origin (Task 2). |
| T-03-08-02 | Information Disclosure | secrets in Railway | high | mitigate | Variables set in the dashboard only; nothing committed; boot errors print key names only. |
| T-03-08-03 | Tampering | TLS on the API subdomain | medium | mitigate | DNS-only CNAME so Railway issues and terminates the certificate (D-15); the human waits for issuance. |
| T-03-08-04 | Denial of Service | no rate limiting yet | medium | accept | Rate limiting is Phase 7; body caps (03-02) bound per-request cost until then. |
| T-03-08-05 | Information Disclosure | leftover test shares | low | mitigate | Every created id deleted and confirmed with head-object. |
</threat_model>
